title: 大阪杯の後に・消えぬ景色

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove put her best foot forward in the Osaka Hai. Afterwards, in the waiting room…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This race was another step towards taking on Suzuka. The question is, where will she be next?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Someone of Silence Suzuka's talents would probably run in…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Agreed. There's no doubt in my mind that's where she'll choose to run next.
choice_data_list: We'll do even better in the Takarazuka Kinen than today.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That we will. I'll definitely defeat Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove begins to pack her things, but something seems off about her…
